translations.answer: From Jazzy, hardware component provides a child logger inherited from ControllerManager. The original author upgraded Jazzy and changed `rclcpp::get_logger("hardware_interface")` to the component's `get_logger()`, and confirmed that Foxglove can see the log; the official demo linked to the maintainer also uses this notation. This conclusion does not include Iron backport, and does not represent a real-time read/write loop high-frequency log print.
translations.applicability: Applies to ROS 2 Jazzy and versions with the same hardware child logger API.
translations.credibility.rationale: The issue has been closed, the environment is clear and there is no conflict. It has formal documentation or precise independent reproducibility.
translations.details.attempts.0: Upgraded to Jazzy and changed the macro parameter to the component's `get_logger()`.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: Confirmed that the distro provides a hardware component child logger, and compared the behavior of standalone logger and the component's `get_logger()` in rosout.
translations.details.effective_fixes.0: Use `RCLCPP_INFO(get_logger(), ...)` within the Jazzy hardware component.
translations.details.environments.0: Original environment: ROS 2 Iron; author verified after upgrading to Jazzy; custom Moteus hardware interface; Foxglove.
translations.details.limits.0: The interface boundary was established from Jazzy onward; Iron should not assume availability; no thread given backport.
translations.details.limits.1: Logs in real-time `read/write` high-frequency paths may still disrupt timing, and this card only responds to logger ownership.
translations.details.outcomes.0: Original author confirmed the log is visible in Foxglove after the upgrade; the official ros2_control demo source code uses the same notation.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: Why does the hardware interface log only appear in the terminal and not in `/rosout`? What logger should Jazzy use?
translations.details.safety_notes.0: Fault logs should be throttled and separated from real-time state sampling; do not use logs in high-frequency WBC loops to replace watchdogs.
translations.details.suspected_causes.0: The independent logger used in Iron is not associated with the ControllerManager node's rosout publisher; Jazzy provides a child logger.
translations.details.symptoms.0: `RCLCPP_INFO(rclcpp::get_logger("hardware_interface"), ...)` is visible in the terminal, but not in `/rosout`/Foxglove.
translations.source.locator: ros2_control #2113 maintainer version note 2735617665; author recheck 2764284744; official demo rrbot.cpp
